mentions.story: How to Become a Data Engineer in 2021
mentions.text: Coding and building teach you more than taking a course or watching a video. If you don't have any programming background, you can enroll in some coursera or udacity courses to start with. Then go through this course [course], the course reader is really good. After that for data engineering read this book [link]. Also learn some sql. Take some data, feed into sql light db, and ask question and convert question into query. Becoming good at this takes some time. Be patience. The learning curve is like hokey stick, initial phase might have a dip but it accelerate in the later phase. BY ANY CHANCE DO NOT JOIN A BOOTCAMP.

mentions.author: gleb
mentions.story: On Our Project, We're Always 90% Done
mentions.text:
It's not that we find it hard to write down all remaining work, it's that when we are forced to do it we face the fact that we don't actually understand what all the remaining work is. Often times it's not even possible to understand it, until more work is done.

The main difference between professional software development and cs101 assignments is that you have to do your own decomposition. Check out the last assignment for first CS class in Stanford: [course] This is comparable to the complexity of most professional work. The difference is detailed iterative project plan and scaffolding that's provided to the student.
